texts.facts: The petitioner, on the basis of an agreement entered into with the 3rd respondent herein, constructed a semi-permanent structure, which has been used as a 'Kanjikkada'. The petitioner has filed the captioned writ petition pointing out that he had a licence for running the aforesaid shop, as evidenced by Ext.P3 issued by the 1st respondent Municipality, and though he sought for renewing the licence, the Municipality has not renewed the same, relying on the alleged unauthorised construction, as stated in Exts.P7 and P8. 2.
texts.arguments: The learned counsel for the 3rd respondent submits that, as of now, he is not the owner of the property, insofar as he has sold the same.
texts.petitioner_arguments: The learned counsel for the 3rd respondent submits that, as of now, he is not the owner of the property, insofar as he has sold the same.
